7.q_en: Good afternoon. Thanks Rick, David and Jessie, congrats on your start of your data center ASIC shipments as well.
7.q_zh: 各位午安。謝謝 Rick、David 和 Jessie，也恭喜貴公司開始出貨資料中心 ASIC。

ans.en: Thank you for the question. Let me first address the second ASIC accelerator.
ans.zh: 謝謝您的問題。我先回答第二款 ASIC 加速器。

ans.en: About the revenue of the guidance for second project, maybe I take that. Gokul, normally we don't give out the detail for '28.
ans.zh: 有關第二個專案的營收指引，或許由我回答。Gokul，我們通常不會提供 2028 年的詳細數字。

7.q_en: Got it. Maybe also on the second generation.
7.q_zh: 了解。我也想追問第二代產品。

ans.en: Gokul. Right now we are working on this US IDM packaging process as our absolute priority.
ans.zh: Gokul，我們目前把這家美國 IDM 的封裝製程列為絕對優先事項。事實上，我們現在已經在聯發科技內部建立非常強大的製造團隊，領導團隊中有資歷非常豐富、已退休的晶圓廠營運高階主管。

7.q_en: Good afternoon. Thank you very much for taking my questions and congrats on the very good progress for your key ASIC programs.
7.q_zh: 各位午安。非常感謝接受我的提問，也恭喜關鍵 ASIC 專案取得非常好的進展。

ans.en: We certainly cannot speak for our customers, but we can say we are working very closely with them on the next, next generation ASIC. Again our customer is very aggressive in moving forward and upward in the performance, downwards for the TCO, I guess.
ans.zh: 我們當然不能代表客戶發言，但可以說，我們正與客戶非常密切地合作開發再下一代 ASIC。我們的客戶一如往常，非常積極地朝更高效能邁進，同時也希望降低整體擁有成本（TCO）。

7.q_en: Thank you very much. Very helpful.
7.q_zh: 非常感謝，很有幫助。第二個問題是，先前您提到有機會開拓新客戶，也正在洽談數個雲端 ASIC 合作案。

ans.en: Sunny. I think we just confirmed we do have the second customer.
ans.zh: Sunny，我想我們剛剛已經確認，確實有第二家客戶。新的專案現在已經啟動，相關工作正在進行中，預計第一筆營收會在 2028 年開始貢獻。

7.q_en: Got it. So, second customer is different customer from the key project that you are referring to, right?
7.q_zh: 了解。所以這第二家客戶，確實與你們目前主要專案的那家客戶不同，對嗎？

ans.en: Yes, second customer. So a different customer.
ans.zh: 沒錯，是第二家、不同的客戶。美國銀行（BofA）Hass Liu

7.q_en: Hi Rick, David and Jessie. Congrats on the great results and thanks for taking my questions.

ans.en: Well, our latest, today's guidance for fourth quarter $2.5 billion indeed comes from a very robust customer demand. And with the robust customer demand, actually we have been working very hard with our supply chain partners.
Yes. Okay.

7.q_en: Okay, got it. So just a quick follow-up on that one -- that your operating margin for the ASIC business is already going to be accretive as compared to your corporate average starting from fourth quarter.

ans.en: Yeah. Well, starting from fourth quarter, the operating margin will become attractive to the overall company.

7.q_en: Okay. Okay, got it.

ans.en: Yes, actually I think the journey side kick off already. Again we will provide more detail later on.

7.q_en: Hi Rick. David, thanks for taking my question.
7.q_zh: Rick、David，你們好，謝謝接受提問。若可以的話，我有幾個追問。

ans.en: Okay, first of all, I think it's higher, but we probably won't be able to quantify this, because like I explained, in fourth quarter we also have the effect about a price adjustment starting from third quarter for non- data center business as well. But overall it's higher -- it's higher.
ans.zh: 首先，我認為它確實比較高，但我們可能無法將差距量化。因為如我剛才所說，第四季的營業利益率也受到非資料中心業務自第三季開始調整售價的影響。

7.q_en: Okay, thank you. And can I say my next two questions because I’d love to know the answer for both.
7.q_zh: 好的，謝謝。我想把另外兩個問題一起提出，因為我很想知道兩者的答案。

ans.en: So Charlie, maybe the second customer -- again currently we probably won't be able to provide more detail, but yeah, I think in general maybe the easy way to think about it -- I understand there are some rumors out there -- at least one thing we can say the second customer is not coming from China. Okay, maybe not much we can talk about.
ans.zh: Charlie，關於第二家客戶，目前我們可能仍無法透露更多細節。不過我想，可以用比較簡單的方式來說明——我知道外面有一些傳聞——但至少有一點我們可以確認：第二家客戶不是來自中國。

7.q_en: Got you. Yeah.
7.q_zh: 了解。那能否請管理層談談，如果 CSP 的預算縮減，優先順序會是 ASIC 還是 GPU？

ans.en: Well Charlie, yeah, there's certainly quite a bit of a market movement. There's no question about it during the last several weeks almost.
ans.zh: Charlie，過去幾週市場確實出現不小的波動，這點毫無疑問。但我的看法是，如果把時間拉長到未來一、兩年，甚至三年，AI 需求的成長，也就是運算需求的成長，絕對會持續。

7.q_en: Yeah, thanks for taking my question. I guess you seem pretty dependent on EMIB-T right now.
7.q_zh: 謝謝接受提問。我覺得你們目前似乎相當依賴 EMIB-T。

ans.en: First of all, we are not dependent on one supplier. It is critical to make it clear.
ans.zh: 首先，我們並沒有依賴單一供應商，這一點一定要講清楚。我再強調一次，台積電（TSMC）是我們最重要的合作夥伴，毫無疑問，就是如此。

7.q_en: Just a -- if you just look at the -- just a follow up -- in terms of these frontier model custom silicon projects, your major competitor is using financing, very aggressive financing, buy now pay later type terms. I know you have a small financing that you've raised this debt.
7.q_zh: 我再追問一下。若從前沿 AI 模型公司所使用的客製化晶片專案來看，你們的主要競爭對手正以非常積極的融資方式，例如「先買後付」的付款條件，來爭取業務。

ans.en: Well, Robert, I think the market is so dynamic right now. You're talking about all of -- depends on somebody calls vendor financing or support by the chipset vendors.
ans.zh: Robert，我認為現在市場變化非常快。你提到的情況，有些人稱為供應商融資（vendor financing），也就是由晶片供應商提供財務支援。

7.q_en: Congrats on strong fourth quarter OP margin beat. And two questions, number one is on the OP margin discussion, number two is on the technology learning curve.
7.q_zh: 恭喜第四季營業利益率展望強勁、優於預期。我有兩個問題：第一個關於營業利益率，第二個關於技術學習曲線。

ans.en: Yeah, I think first of all, the long answer short -- I think Q4 operating margin, Q4 should be the starting point of people to see the improving operating margin. Okay, so it's not going to be just sustainable, I think we are looking for continue to enhance given actually we're going to ship more on the top line.
ans.zh: 簡單說，我認為第四季的營業利益率，應該是大家開始看到營業利益率改善的起點。因此它不只是可以維持，我們還預期隨著營收規模進一步擴大，營業利益率將持續提升。

7.q_en: Yeah, that's great. Second question is a follow up on Rick opening remark mentioned that we are doing the leading tech.
7.q_zh: 很好。第二個問題接續 Rick 開場時提到的領先技術。

ans.en: That's a good and a tough question. I want to be careful in responding your question.
ans.zh: 這是個很好、也很難回答的問題，我想謹慎回答。我們在 AI這個既複雜又快速變動的時代，於多項必要技術能力上的進展，確實讓我們很振奮。

7.q_en: Yeah, hi. Thanks for taking my follow up question.
7.q_zh: 你好，謝謝接受我的追問。首先關於與 NVIDIA 的 NVLink Fusion 合作，Rick，我知道現在還不能談具體的 ASIC 產品，但能否多說明你們如何整合 NVLink Fusion，以及客戶能從中獲得哪些好處？

ans.en: Gokul, first, NVLink Fusion model of course, it's a business model but with a very very high and strong technical content. Let's talk about technical content first.
ans.zh: Gokul，首先，NVLink Fusion 當然是一種商業模式，但它同時包含非常高、非常深的技術成分。我們先談技術。

7.q_en: Got it. Any feedback, initial feedback that you're hearing from the customers on this model now?
7.q_zh: 了解。現在是否有從客戶那裡聽到任何初步回饋？

ans.en: Yeah Gokul. Right now, we are in discussion together with NVIDIA with several potential customers.
ans.zh: Gokul，目前我們正與 NVIDIA 一起跟數家潛在客戶討論。整體來說，有些客戶相當喜歡這個模式。

7.q_en: Got it. That's very good.
7.q_zh: 了解，這非常好。第二個問題還是想再談第二代 ASIC。

ans.en: Sure. Gokul.
ans.zh: 當然。Gokul，我認為重點正如 Rick 在開場時所提到的：第二代產品，也就是第二個專案，在每單位耗電量所能提供的效能上，會提升數倍，因而帶來更好的整體擁有成本（TCO）。

7.q_en: Thanks for taking my follow-up question. So I want to ask about the 448 gigabit SerDes we know, is that for the third generation project with major customer or it would be applied for this so-called second customer?
7.q_zh: 謝謝接受追問。我想問 448Gbps SerDes。

ans.en: Yeah. Well, first of all, we certainly serve our current customer first and 448 is a must going forward with a very stringent PAM6 design with a very stringent power consumption requirements, and we have taped out already.
ans.zh: 首先，我們當然會優先服務現有客戶。展望未來，448G 是不可或缺的技術，而且採用的 PAM6 設計非常嚴苛，對功耗的要求也非常高。

7.q_en: Yeah and we are also looking forward to your more projects and not just NVLink Fusion that David just mentioned, but we are -- we believe you'll have a great opportunity with other US CSP or AI Lab customers. But for this already announced so-called second customer win, may we get a rough kind of revenue size or margin profile?
7.q_zh: 我們也期待你們取得更多專案。不只剛才 David 提到的 NVLink Fusion，我們也認為你們有很好的機會與其他美國 CSP 或 AI 實驗室客戶合作。

ans.en: Right now, it's a little bit too early to talk about detail but in general, I guess actually the demand the customer would like, actually is pretty strong. But again for 2028 we're still in the process about finalizing the supply, so we probably would provide some more detail later on.
ans.zh: 現在要談詳細數字還稍嫌太早。不過整體而言，我想這位客戶的需求確實相當強勁。

7.q_en: And David, you mentioned about substrates several times. That is a key factor, right?
7.q_zh: David，你已經數次提到基板，它是個關鍵因素，對吧？假設 EMIB-T 的供應無法滿足客戶需求，你們認為第一代專案的產品生命週期會因此延長，還是需求會轉向美國的競爭對手，採用台積電 CoWoS 封裝的方案？

ans.en: I think for current generation the demand looks good. And also like with the guidance we gave out, actually we should feel fairly comfortable to deliver what the customer wants for generation one.
ans.zh: 我認為目前這一代產品的需求看起來不錯，而且根據我們提供的指引，對於滿足客戶對第一代產品的需求，我們相當有信心。至於第二代產品，以目前的良率狀況及產品上市時程來看，我們仍有信心能夠滿足客戶的基本需求。

8: For 2027, we expect this program to achieve the high end of our revenue target range of approximately US$16 billion, representing around 20% of the total AI accelerator ASIC market.
第二款 ASIC 量產時程

Additionally, with close collaboration with our advanced packaging partner, the yield and reliability of the second ASIC are on track for high volume production in 2028, and we’re confident in capturing additional market share when this ASIC ramps up.
For our second AI accelerator project, the development is progressing well, and we are on track for high- volume production in the first quarter of 2028.
With that, we now aim to achieve the high-end of our full year revenue target range, which is high-single digit percentage growth in US dollars.
Based on our fourth quarter guidance, we now expect our full year revenue growth to exceed our previous target of high-single-digit percentage growth in US dollars.

For gross margin, through our disciplined pricing strategy that reflects the rising costs throughout the supply chain, we aim to deliver our full year gross margin within the current quarter guidance range.

tr.en: For 2027, we expect this program to achieve the high end of our revenue target range of approximately US$16 billion, representing around 20% of the total AI accelerator ASIC market.
tr.zh: 對於2027年，我們預期此專案將達到營收目標區間的高標，大約為US$16 billion，約佔整體AI accelerator ASIC市場的20%。

tr.en: We expect our fourth quarter revenue to be in the range of NT$210.1 billion dollars to NT$221.8 billion dollars, grow 25% to 32% sequentially, and up 40% to 48% year-over-year at a forecasted exchange rate of 31.7 NT dollars to 1 US dollar.
tr.zh: 我們預期第四季營收將介於NT$210.1 billion dollars至NT$221.8 billion dollars之間，較前一季成長25%至32%，較去年同期成長40%至48%，預估匯率為31.7 NT dollars兌1 US dollar。

tr.en: Gross margin is forecasted at 45%, plus or minus 1.5 percentage points, and operating expense ratio is forecasted at 26%, plus or minus 2 percentage points.
tr.zh: 預估毛利率為45%，正負1.5個百分點，預估營業費用率為26%，正負2個百分點。

tr.en: Based on our fourth quarter guidance, we now expect our full year revenue growth to exceed our previous target of high-single-digit percentage growth in US dollars.
tr.zh: 基於我們的第四季財測，我們現在預期全年營收成長將超過先前以US dollars計算的高個位數百分比成長目標。

tr.en: In addition, we continue to drive solid progress in our data center and edge device businesses.
tr.zh: 此外，我們的data center與edge device業務持續取得穩健進展。

tr.en: For data center, demand for our first AI accelerator remains very strong.
tr.zh: 在data center方面，對我們第一個AI accelerator的需求依然非常強勁。

tr.en: The successful ramp of our first AI accelerator marks an important milestone, demonstrating our ability to integrate industry-leading interconnect IPs, advanced process and advanced packaging technologies, together with our capabilities to orchestrate global supply chain, we are now able to deliver a highly competitive custom silicon for data centers.
tr.zh: 我們第一個AI accelerator的成功量產標誌著一個重要里程碑，展現了我們整合業界領先的interconnect IPs、先進製程與先進封裝技術的能力，結合我們協調全球供應鏈的能力，我們現在能夠為data centers提供極具競爭力的客製化矽晶片（custom silicon）。

tr.en: For our second AI accelerator project, the development is progressing well, and we are on track for high- volume production in the first quarter of 2028.
tr.zh: 針對我們的第二個AI accelerator專案，開發進展順利，我們正按計畫於2028年第一季進行大規模量產。

tr.en: Meanwhile, we continue to make solid progress across key enabling technologies, including 448G SerDes, 3.5D advanced packaging, and co-packaged optics.
tr.zh: 同時，我們在關鍵賦能技術上持續取得穩健進展，包括448G SerDes、3.5D advanced packaging與co-packaged optics。

tr.en: This was primarily driven by the better-than-expected customer demand and improving supply.
tr.zh: 這主要是由優於預期的客戶需求以及不斷改善的供應所驅動。

tr.en: This not only strengthened our partnership with key AI infrastructure partners but also enhanced our ability to secure capacity for critical components for business expansion.
tr.zh: 這不僅強化了我們與關鍵AI infrastructure合作夥伴的夥伴關係，也增強了我們為業務擴張取得關鍵零組件產能的能力。

tr.en: This confidence is underpinned by our solid supply outlook.
tr.zh: 這項信心獲得我們穩健供應前景的支撐。

tr.en: We are working closely with our supply chain partners for additional capacity to meet the strong customer demand.
tr.zh: 我們正與供應鏈合作夥伴密切合作，以取得額外產能來滿足強勁的客戶需求。

tr.en: These tape-outs of such complex dies are very challenging, and those guys, my hat’s off to them.
tr.zh: 這些複雜晶粒（dies）的試產（tape-outs）非常具挑戰性，那些夥伴們，我向他們致敬。

tr.en: Because the reason we don't want to give all the detail is '28 there are so many moving pieces on the supply chain situation.
tr.zh: 因為我們不想給出所有細節的原因是，28年的供應鏈狀況有太多變數。

tr.en: We're still in the process of finalizing the supply chain situation.
tr.zh: 我們仍在敲定供應鏈狀況的過程中。

tr.en: And we are working very closely with IDM partner and substrate suppliers, first and foremost on the yield improvements.
tr.zh: 我們正與IDM合作夥伴及基板（substrate）供應商非常緊密地合作，首要之務是良率的改善。

tr.en: We have already commenced initial shipments in September and are confident of delivering 2.5 billion US dollars revenue in the fourth quarter.
tr.zh: 我們已於9月開始初步出貨，並且有信心在第四季實現2.5 billion US dollars的營收。

tr.en: In the third quarter, Mobile Phone declined 1% quarter-over-quarter and declined 17% year-over-year, accounting for 37% of total revenue.
tr.zh: 在第三季中，Mobile Phone較前一季下滑1%，較去年同期下滑17%，佔總營收的37%。

tr.en: Additionally, with close collaboration with our advanced packaging partner, the yield and reliability of the second ASIC are on track for high volume production in 2028, and we’re confident in capturing additional market share when this ASIC ramps up.
tr.zh: 此外，透過與先進封裝合作夥伴的密切合作，第二個ASIC的良率與可靠度正按計畫於2028年進行大規模量產，我們有信心在此ASIC放量時拿下更多的市場佔有率。

tr.en: With that, we now aim to achieve the high-end of our full year revenue target range, which is high-single digit percentage growth in US dollars.
tr.zh: 因此，我們現在的目標是達到全年營收目標區間的高標，也就是以US dollars計算的高個位數百分比成長。

tr.en: For gross margin, through our disciplined pricing strategy that reflects the rising costs throughout the supply chain, we aim to deliver our full year gross margin within the current quarter guidance range.
tr.zh: 在毛利率方面，透過反映供應鏈成本上升的紀律化訂價策略，我們的目標是將全年毛利率維持在當季財測區間之內。

tr.en: Good afternoon. Thanks Rick, David and Jessie, congrats on your start of your data center ASIC shipments as well.
tr.zh: 午安。謝謝Rick、David和Jessie，也恭喜你們開始出貨data center ASIC。

tr.en: Thank you for the question. Let me first address the second ASIC accelerator.
tr.zh: 謝謝你的提問。我先回答第二個ASIC accelerator的問題。

tr.en: About the revenue of the guidance for second project, maybe I take that. Gokul, normally we don't give out the detail for '28.
tr.zh: 關於第二個專案的營收財測，也許我來回答。Gokul，我們通常不會透露28年的細節。

tr.en: Got it. Maybe also on the second generation.
tr.zh: 了解。也許也談談第二代。

tr.en: Gokul. Right now we are working on this US IDM packaging process as our absolute priority.
tr.zh: Gokul。我們現在正將這個US IDM封裝製程作為我們的絕對優先事項。

tr.en: Good afternoon. Thank you very much for taking my questions and congrats on the very good progress for your key ASIC programs.
tr.zh: 午安。非常感謝您回答我的問題，並恭喜你們在關鍵ASIC專案上取得很好的進展。

tr.en: We certainly cannot speak for our customers, but we can say we are working very closely with them on the next, next generation ASIC. Again our customer is very aggressive in moving forward and upward in the performance, downwards for the TCO, I guess.
tr.zh: 我們當然無法為客戶發言，但我們可以說我們正與他們就下下代ASIC進行非常密切的合作。同樣地，我們的客戶在效能上積極推進與提升，我猜在TCO上則是積極降低。

tr.en: Thank you very much. Very helpful.
tr.zh: 非常感謝。非常實用。

tr.en: Sunny. I think we just confirmed we do have the second customer.
tr.zh: Sunny。我想我們剛才已經證實我們確實有第二個客戶。

tr.en: Got it. So, second customer is different customer from the key project that you are referring to, right?
tr.zh: 了解。所以，第二個客戶是不同於你所提到的那個關鍵專案的客戶，對吧？

tr.en: Yes, second customer. So a different customer.
tr.zh: 對，第二個客戶。所以是不同的客戶。

tr.en: Hi Rick, David and Jessie. Congrats on the great results and thanks for taking my questions.
tr.zh: 嗨Rick、David和Jessie。恭喜出色的業績，並謝謝你們回答我的問題。

tr.en: Well, our latest, today's guidance for fourth quarter $2.5 billion indeed comes from a very robust customer demand. And with the robust customer demand, actually we have been working very hard with our supply chain partners.
tr.zh: 嗯，我們最新、今天的第四季2.5 billion dollars財測確實來自非常強勁的客戶需求。在強勁的客戶需求下，其實我們一直與供應鏈合作夥伴非常努力地合作。

tr.en: Yes. Okay.
tr.zh: 好。好的。

tr.en: Okay, got it. So just a quick follow-up on that one -- that your operating margin for the ASIC business is already going to be accretive as compared to your corporate average starting from fourth quarter.
tr.zh: 好的，我明白了。所以想簡單追問一個問題——即你們ASIC業務的營業利益率（operating margin）從第四季開始就已經會高於你們的公司平均（accretive）嗎？

tr.en: Yeah. Well, starting from fourth quarter, the operating margin will become attractive to the overall company.
tr.zh: 對。嗯，從第四季開始，營業利益率對整個公司而言將會具吸引力（attractive）。

tr.en: Okay. Okay, got it.
tr.zh: 好的。好的，我明白了。

tr.en: Yes, actually I think the journey side kick off already. Again we will provide more detail later on.
tr.zh: 是的，其實我認為這段旅程已經展開了。同樣地，我們稍後會提供更多細節。

tr.en: Hi Rick. David, thanks for taking my question.
tr.zh: 嗨Rick。David，謝謝你們回答我的問題。

tr.en: Okay, first of all, I think it's higher, but we probably won't be able to quantify this, because like I explained, in fourth quarter we also have the effect about a price adjustment starting from third quarter for non- data center business as well. But overall it's higher -- it's higher.
tr.zh: 好的，首先，我認為它會更高，但我們可能無法將其量化，因為就像我解釋的，在第四季我們也受到自第三季開始針對非data center業務進行價格調整的影響。但整體而言它更高——它更高。

tr.en: Okay, thank you. And can I say my next two questions because I’d love to know the answer for both.
tr.zh: 好的，謝謝。我能提出接下來的兩個問題嗎，因為我很想知道兩者的答案。

tr.en: So Charlie, maybe the second customer -- again currently we probably won't be able to provide more detail, but yeah, I think in general maybe the easy way to think about it -- I understand there are some rumors out there -- at least one thing we can say the second customer is not coming from China. Okay, maybe not much we can talk about.
tr.zh: 所以Charlie，關於第二個客戶——同樣地，目前我們可能無法提供更多細節，但對吧，我想大致上簡單的思考方式是——我知道外面有一些傳言——至少有一件事我們可以說，第二個客戶不是來自中國。好的，可能沒有太多我們可以談論的。

tr.en: Got you. Yeah.
tr.zh: 了解。好的。

tr.en: Well Charlie, yeah, there's certainly quite a bit of a market movement. There's no question about it during the last several weeks almost.
tr.zh: 嗯Charlie，對，過去幾週市場確實有相當大的變動。幾乎毫無疑問。

tr.en: Yeah, thanks for taking my question. I guess you seem pretty dependent on EMIB-T right now.
tr.zh: 對，謝謝你們回答我的問題。我猜你們現在似乎相當依賴EMIB-T。

tr.en: First of all, we are not dependent on one supplier. It is critical to make it clear.
tr.zh: 首先，我們並不依賴單一供應商。釐清這一點至關重要。

tr.en: Just a -- if you just look at the -- just a follow up -- in terms of these frontier model custom silicon projects, your major competitor is using financing, very aggressive financing, buy now pay later type terms. I know you have a small financing that you've raised this debt.
tr.zh: 補充一個——如果你看一下——只是一個追問——在這些前沿模型（frontier model）客製化矽晶片專案方面，你們的主要競爭對手正在使用融資、非常激進的融資，像是先買後付（buy now pay later）類型的條款。我知道你們籌集了一小筆債務融資。

tr.en: Well, Robert, I think the market is so dynamic right now. You're talking about all of -- depends on somebody calls vendor financing or support by the chipset vendors.
tr.zh: 嗯，Robert，我認為現在市場非常動態。你所談論的全部——取決於有些人稱之為供應商融資（vendor financing）或由晶片組供應商支持的事宜。

tr.en: Congrats on strong fourth quarter OP margin beat. And two questions, number one is on the OP margin discussion, number two is on the technology learning curve.
tr.zh: 恭喜第四季OP margin超出預期。我有兩個問題，第一是關於OP margin的討論，第二是關於技術學習曲線。

tr.en: Yeah, I think first of all, the long answer short -- I think Q4 operating margin, Q4 should be the starting point of people to see the improving operating margin. Okay, so it's not going to be just sustainable, I think we are looking for continue to enhance given actually we're going to ship more on the top line.
tr.zh: 對，我想首先，簡單來說——我認為Q4營業利益率，Q4應該是大家看到營業利益率改善的起點。好的，所以它不會只是曇花一現（sustainable），我認為隨著我們營收規模（top line）出貨增加，我們正尋求持續提升。

tr.en: Yeah, that's great. Second question is a follow up on Rick opening remark mentioned that we are doing the leading tech.
tr.zh: 對，那太好了。第二個問題是關於Rick開場致詞提到我們正在做領先技術的追問。

tr.en: That's a good and a tough question. I want to be careful in responding your question.
tr.zh: 這是一個好問題也是一個棘手的問題。我在回答你的問題時必須謹慎。

tr.en: Yeah, hi. Thanks for taking my follow up question.
tr.zh: 對，嗨。謝謝你回答我的追問。

tr.en: Gokul, first, NVLink Fusion model of course, it's a business model but with a very very high and strong technical content. Let's talk about technical content first.
tr.zh: Gokul，首先，NVLink Fusion模型當然是一個商業模式，但它具有非常非常高且強健的技術內涵。我們先談技術內涵。

tr.en: Got it. Any feedback, initial feedback that you're hearing from the customers on this model now?
tr.zh: 了解。你們現在從客戶端聽到關於這個模型的任何回饋、初步回饋是什麼？

tr.en: Yeah Gokul. Right now, we are in discussion together with NVIDIA with several potential customers.
tr.zh: 對Gokul。目前，我們正與NVIDIA一同與幾家潛在客戶進行討論。

tr.en: Got it. That's very good.
tr.zh: 了解。那非常好。

tr.en: Sure. Gokul.
tr.zh: 當然。Gokul。

tr.en: Thanks for taking my follow-up question. So I want to ask about the 448 gigabit SerDes we know, is that for the third generation project with major customer or it would be applied for this so-called second customer?
tr.zh: 謝謝你們回答我的追問。我想問關於448 gigabit SerDes，我們知道，這是針對主要客戶的第三代專案，還是會應用於這個所謂的第二個客戶？

tr.en: Yeah. Well, first of all, we certainly serve our current customer first and 448 is a must going forward with a very stringent PAM6 design with a very stringent power consumption requirements, and we have taped out already.
tr.zh: 對。嗯，首先，我們當然優先服務我們目前的客戶，而448是未來的必備項目，採用非常嚴格的PAM6設計以及非常嚴格的功耗要求，我們已經完成試產（taped out）。

tr.en: Yeah and we are also looking forward to your more projects and not just NVLink Fusion that David just mentioned, but we are -- we believe you'll have a great opportunity with other US CSP or AI Lab customers. But for this already announced so-called second customer win, may we get a rough kind of revenue size or margin profile?
tr.zh: 對，我們也很期待你們有更多專案，不只是David剛剛提到的NVLink Fusion，我們也相信你們在其他US CSP或AI Lab客戶中會有很好的機會。但對於這個已經宣布的所謂第二個客戶贏單，我們能否得知約略的營收規模或毛利率結構（margin profile）？

tr.en: Right now, it's a little bit too early to talk about detail but in general, I guess actually the demand the customer would like, actually is pretty strong. But again for 2028 we're still in the process about finalizing the supply, so we probably would provide some more detail later on.
tr.zh: 現在要談論細節還稍嫌過早，但大致上，我猜其實客戶想要的實際需求相當強勁。不過同樣地，對於2028年，我們仍在敲定供應的過程中，所以我們可能稍後會提供更多細節。

tr.en: And David, you mentioned about substrates several times. That is a key factor, right?
tr.zh: 而David，你多次提到基板（substrates）。那是一個關鍵因素，對吧？

tr.en: I think for current generation the demand looks good. And also like with the guidance we gave out, actually we should feel fairly comfortable to deliver what the customer wants for generation one.
tr.zh: 我認為就目前這一代而言，需求看起來不錯。而且就像我們給出的財測一樣，其實我們應該對滿足第一代客戶的需求感到相當有信心。
